summary: Added three fake inspector web-extension panels (Console, Changes, Docs) under apps/app/src/lib/agent-client/fake-client/inspector/ and wired them into the dev-only `?fake` branch of main.ts so the right-rail is no longer empty. Verified in the browser via Playwright screenshots and via svelte-check, the UI-hooks check, and the app test suite (235 passed).
decisions: Fake inspector panels register directly into the web-extension registry instead of going through listWebExtensionBundles → blob-URL loader, because the loader exists to evaluate untrusted source strings and stubs would have to be hand-written as source to use it; registration stays inside the dev-only `?fake` branch so it never reaches production.
Panel ids match seeded project integration ids (unity.console, git.changes, svelte.docs) so the tab set tracks Configure toggles live, with Console showing a red `1` badge to exercise badge styling.
